text:
jo: Heads-up: new quickstart onboarding flake when users enable json_mode + register tools. Reproable locally and in CI.

samir: Ugh, details?

jo: Steps: npx redwood-quickstart -> register a tool that returns a JSON payload as a plain string -> call client.chat({ json_mode: true, tools: [...] }) with an AJV schema. Intermittently the SDK helper returns: 
`'\"{\"op\":\"open\",\"path\":\"/tmp/x\"}\"' or `{\"op\":\"open\",...}` and AJV errors on the leading backtick/quote.

cam: Is this happening across runtimes? Node, Python, Go?

yuki: We reproed on Node and Go. Node team already merged a skip-safe-wrap change in the last patch, but Go SDK still has the old safe-wrap behavior. That created a parity mismatch in our sample-app templates and CI integration tests.

beth: I also saw CI flakes tied to auth refresh around the same runs: logs show multiple concurrent refresh attempts and occasional "RetryError: auth refresh failed" which surfaces as the SDK returning an auth failure string instead of model output, confusing the parser.

samir: Two separate failures that amplify each other in quickstart: 1) parity/safe-wrap in Go SDK 2) auth refresh race causing some responses to be auth error strings that then get wrapped/escaped.

jo: Proposed short-term mitigations: add env toggle in sample-app README to disable safe-wrap (REDWOOD_SDK_SAFE_WRAP=0) so new users don't hit this while we patch; add CI guard that disables parallel auth-heavy tests during the patch window.

yuki: Long term: 1) make helper respect request.json_mode === true or response_hint === 'structured' and skip quoting/escaping; 2) add parse_with_raw util that returns {ok:false, error, raw} to help integrators log original text; 3) infra: serialize token refresh so queued requests await a single refresh promise and fail cleanly if refresh fails.

beth: For parity: I'll open a Go PR to implement skip-safe-wrap + parse_with_raw and add unit tests (cases: backtick-wrapped, escaped-string, auth-error-string).

cam: I'll add a tiny middleware suggestion: SDK should set response_hint metadata when tools are registered (e.g., tools: [{name: 'fs', returns: 'json'}]) so the runtime and helpers can be explicit rather than heuristic-based.

samir: Good idea. Also add telemetry: failed_schema_parse event capturing sdk_name, sdk_version, route, sample of raw text (truncated), env flags. That will help correlate with auth refresh logs.

jo: I'll draft a short migration blurb for the changelog and the quickstart README showing the env toggle and how to inspect raw responses.

yuki: I'll open the Go PR now. Samir, can you file the infra ticket for refresh serialization?

samir: Filed infra-5980: "serialize token refresh; return shared promise to queued requests; include clearer RetryError codes" assigned to infra.

beth: PR opened: #4555 (go-sdk: skip safe-wrap when json_mode, add ParseWithRaw). CI queued.

deploy-bot: release-bot: PR #4555 opened by beth, CI started.

jo: Thanks all. After merges: 1) patch releases across SDKs 2) bump sample-app templates 3) remove quickstart env toggle and announce in #devex with migration steps.

yuki: tagging eng-ml for tool-return-type hints to ensure we don't regress UI markdown needs when skipping safe-wrap.

jo: Will follow up with CI links and a small playbook for debugging structured-output failures.
